note: 10-20 scalp-electrode positions in MNI mm (RAS: +X right, +Y anterior, +Z superior), consistent with the ICBM152 meshes. Values are the FieldTrip/Oostenveld standard_1020 template (already in MNI mm scalp-surface coordinates), used because MNE-Python's standard_1005 montage ships in fiducial-based 'head' coordinates rather than MNI. These are SCALP sites; TMSCoil projects each onto the scalp surface along the head-centroid radial. The F3 preset uses the F3 ELECTRODE site (the Beam-F3 coil position), NOT a cortical DLPFC target. NOTE: Okamoto 2004 (often cited for 10-20 MNI coords) reports CORTICAL PROJECTION points, not scalp positions, so it is not cited here. See citations.json -> standard-1020-electrodes.
